verdict.rationale: DBOS documents running workflows on a cron schedule. Schedules are stored in the database and can be created, paused, resumed, and deleted at runtime, and they can also be managed through the Conductor HTTP API and the dbosctl CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled workflows, and documentation of schedule semantics such as missed-run handling or timezones.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: You can schedule DBOS workflows to run on a cron schedule. Schedules are stored in the database and can be created, paused, resumed, and deleted at runtime.
Conductor's workflow, queue, and schedule management is available over an OpenAPI-described HTTP API and from the dbosctl command-line client
It manages workflows, queues, schedules, applications, and API keys against DBOS-managed Conductor or a self-hosted Conductor
